Morgan Stanley leaks deal pipeline including India IPOs

Morgan Stanley accidentally leaked a list of over 100 deals in its pipeline, including initial public offerings (IPOs) in India, due to an email misfire. The leak reportedly occurred when the investment bank sent an email containing the confidential deal information.
